modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Business and first class passengers may carry two pieces; economy passengers one.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Each piece up to 55CM (22 inches) x 40CM (16 inches) x 20CM (8 inches), with the three sides adding up to no more than 115CM (46 inches).

carryon_weight.value: Business class: 2 pieces, each up to 8KG (or 17LB). Economy class: 1 piece up to 5KG (or 11LB). The same limits apply on domestic and on international, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan routes.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Juneyao uses a weight concept on international and Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan routes; these rules apply to tickets sold and flights from August 7, 2025.

allowance_by_cabin.value: International and Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan routes: business class 30 KG total; regular economy class 20 KG total; infants without a seat 0 KG (plus a free foldable stroller).

size_weight.value: Each checked piece up to 100 × 60 × 40CM (length x width x height).
